name: Emerging Agricultural Technology

objectives.text: Identify examples of emerging technologies used on modern farms and ranches, such as robotic milkers, automated feeders, and autonomous tractors
Describe how a specific emerging technology helps a farmer solve a real problem such as a labor shortage, animal care demands, or crop loss
Explain how controlled environment agriculture systems such as vertical farms and automated hydroponic greenhouses grow crops year-round
Explain how agricultural robots use cameras, machine vision, and programmed decisions to perform tasks such as weeding, harvesting, or milking
Describe how artificial intelligence and data analytics turn farm records into management recommendations for a producer
Compare a conventional method of completing a farm task with an automated method in terms of time, labor, and consistency
Analyze how automation changes the labor needs and skill requirements of a specific farm task
Identify automation and climate control technologies used in modern animal production facilities and explain how they affect animal welfare and efficiency
Operate an automated system such as a computerized feeding system or greenhouse environmental controller to carry out a production task in a lab or SAE setting
Analyze how emerging production technologies such as vertical farming and alternative proteins align with sustainable practices and natural resource use
Explain how digital traceability tools such as blockchain records track agricultural products from the farm through the supply chain
Analyze career pathways created by emerging agricultural technology and the technical skills each requires
Evaluate the benefits and limitations of adopting a specific emerging technology for a given farm or food operation
Analyze the financial impact of purchasing a major technology asset such as a robotic milking system using a partial budget and payback period
Evaluate the ethical, privacy, and data ownership issues raised when technology companies collect and use farm data
Justify a technology adoption plan for a farm that weighs cost, employee training needs, and expected return
Create a proposal for an emerging technology solution to a problem in an SAE or local operation suitable for presentation in an FFA agriscience or ag technology event

changes: Kept and reworded the grade 6, 9, 11, and 12 objectives. Dropped the grade 7 sensor network objective (belongs to Drones & Agricultural Sensors) and the grade 8 autosteer objective (belongs to GPS, GIS & Precision Agriculture). Added competencies on controlled environment agriculture, robotics and machine vision, AI and data analytics, conventional versus automated comparison, animal facility automation, hands-on operation of automated systems, sustainability of emerging production systems, digital traceability, careers, asset purchase analysis, data ethics, and an FFA-ready technology proposal. Anchored grade 9 to 12 objectives to fitting AFNR standards.
